question: Can one reciprocal Smith chord become a parameterized two-sheeted pole carrier whose exact arc imbalance, sheet metric, conic phase, and triangular holonomy remain separately observable?
theory_to_structure: one oriented chord -> plane intersection q, axis direction u, and two pole sheets
one discrete edge -> Delta P plus/minus = Delta q plus/minus r Delta u
pole-length sum -> common translation and precession activity
pole-length difference -> oriented cross-coupling Delta q dot Delta u
two parameter directions -> two induced sheet metrics and their common/coupling factors
direct versus composed face transport -> exact connection holonomy
one conic matrix pencil -> circle, ellipse, discriminant line-pair, and hyperbola phases

smith_chord_precession.exact_interpretation: The prior reciprocal Smith points are the ends of one chord. A rational tilt makes the plane cut asymmetric; a later rational rotation about the plane normal precesses both the actual intersection and the stereographic direction by the same unit complex phase.

edges.label: precession without translation
edges.interpretation: Both poles traverse equal elementary arcs; all activity is orientation change.

edges.label: translation orthogonal to precession
edges.interpretation: Translation and axis change coexist but their exact cross-coupling vanishes.

edges.label: translation coupled to precession
edges.interpretation: The cross-term makes the two pole arcs unequal; swapping pole hand reverses the swing.

two_parameter_sheet_metric.exact_interpretation: The average metric retains common translation-plus-precession activity. The half-difference is an oriented mixed tensor; averaging the pole sheets alone would erase it.

triangular_connection_faces.label: flat precession triangle
triangular_connection_faces.exact_interpretation: The direct edge and the two-edge precession return the same target frame; the triangle carries no connection residual.

triangular_connection_faces.label: curved mixed-axis triangle
triangular_connection_faces.exact_interpretation: The direct and composed routes reach one base vertex with different frames and pole placements; their exact holonomy is the face curvature.

conic_phase_path.exact_interpretation: Circle, ellipse, and hyperbola are distinct real affine-chart faces of one nonsingular projective conic class. At mu=0 the matrix determinant vanishes and the conic becomes a pair of lines; that seam may supply simplicial edges but is not itself a triangle.

consequence: The reciprocal Smith sheets now form an exact movable chord rather than two isolated plotted points. Their plane intersection and direction precess by the same rational complex phase, while the two pole paths expose translation, orientation change, and their cross-coupling without averaging. Triangular holonomy and conic discriminant remain independent typed seams.
construction_boundary: This cell supplies the discrete geometric carrier needed by the proposed global response law. It does not yet identify the completed Weil response with the sheet metric, prove that every nontrivial Xi zero is a spectral mode of this connection, or exclude a nonzero normal chord.
